title: Ask walks share one model instead of loading a fresh 23 GB copy for every walk
goal: Every Ask walk starts a new copy of the app, and every copy loads the whole Ask model from scratch (about 23 GB, GPU at 100% for a minute or more), so a walk check with a dozen Ask walks loads it a dozen times in a row. Walks in one run should share one model that is already loaded, run gently, and is let go when the run ends.
notes: Measured in the intake window on 2026-10-25: one ask-annotates-a-screenshot-walk = one fresh llama-server, 22.8 GB RSS, GPU 99-100% for about 80 s, free memory 93% to 58%, no swap. The GPU-latency probe (a tiny Metal blit every 50 ms) stayed under 7 ms even under load, so this is waste and heat rather than proven keyboard theft; the focus theft the user hit was the focus drill's canary, fixed in eeaf8747. Server launch: Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskModelServer.swift (AskHelperProcess ties the server to the app pid), args: AskBuiltInServerPlan.arguments in Sources/PhotonzCore/AskBuiltInModel.swift (--parallel is already 1). Bench scripts used: the gpulat.swift and bench.sh approach (start llama-server on a spare port, one ~3000-token request, time a 1 MB Metal blit every 50 ms).
acceptance: One walk run (rotating check, whole set, or Scripts/playtest-all.sh) starts at most one model server for the default Ask model, and every Ask walk in the run uses it. MEASURED: sample the number of llama-server processes every 2s through a rotating check that includes 5+ ask-* walks; the maximum is 1 and the model loads once (the audit shows the sample log).

The shared server is started outside the probe app with gentle settings (background scheduling, low priority, no busy polling, smaller GPU batches) and its cost is measured: prompt and generation speed vs today's settings, plus a GPU-latency probe while it works. Reference numbers from 2026-10-25: today's settings 218 t/s prompt, 28.6 t/s generation; gentle (taskpolicy -b, --ubatch-size 128 --batch-size 512 --prio -1 --poll 0 --threads 4) 196 and 26.7, GPU latency p99 2.8 ms vs 3.5.

The shared server has a bounded life: it stops when the run ends, when the loop stops, and on its own after a few idle minutes, so nothing is left loaded (queue/bin/never-leave-machine-loaded style check: after the run, no llama-server is running).

A walk that asks for a different model, or for none (askModelMissing, askModelsOnly), still gets exactly what it asks for; the people-facing app is unchanged (Ask in the dev or release app still starts and lets go of its own server).
Nothing it starts takes the front or the keyboard: queue/bin/focus-drill.sh on two ask walks reads clean.
Logic that decides whether a probe adopts the shared server lives in PhotonzCore with unit tests first.

log.note: triage 2026-10-26: the rotating check has been stuck on the Ask block (cursor 103) since 2026-10-25 midday, stopped on its 30 minute clock three times running. Moving the cursor is its own task, the-rotating-walk-check-moves-on-through-the-set; this one makes each Ask walk cheaper.

Plan: during a walk (no askModelMissing/askModelsOnly) the probe adopts a shared llama-server recorded in ~/Library/Caches/Photonz/ask-walk-server, or starts one detached (not under the probe's pid watch) with gentle settings under taskpolicy -b. A small sh watch stops it when the run owner (playtest-all.sh, or a standalone playtest.sh) is gone or after 180 s idle (/slots is_processing refreshes the clock). playtest-all/playtest.sh/go-loop stop it on the way out via Scripts/ask-walk-server.sh. Lazy start (from the probe) over harness pre-start, because a walk that never asks the model must not load 23 GB. The picture model server (AskPictureServer) is out of scope: the task names the default Ask model.

Bench 2026-10-30 (Qwen3.8 27B with its draft, one 2412-token request, bench script and GPU probe in queue/audits/2026-10-30-ask-walks-share-one-model-*): app settings 232 t/s read, 42.8 t/s write, GPU 1 MB blit p50 0.70 p99 2.8 ms; gentle (taskpolicy -b, ubatch 128, batch 512, prio -1, poll 0, threads 4) 212 and 39.7, p50 0.42 p99 4.2 ms. About 9% slower; latency either way far inside a frame.

Measured: Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build ask- (36 walks, 16m 25s) with llama-server sampled every 2 s: 444 samples at 1, 41 at 0, never 2; one start (shared server log), let go on its own idle clock, nothing running after. Only 4 walks reached the model (Command-K on a video, both photo walks, paints-before-brushes): 27 Ask walks fail before asking because pressing Ask opens no composer, a regression from between the 10-23 and 10-26 sweeps, logged with reproduction on walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26. Before this change, those 4 would have been 4 loads. Standalone playtest.sh run of the Command-K walk twice in one owned run: one start, the second walk adopted it, stopped 'told' at the end.

focus-drill: ask-sheen-every-hover-walk, ask-adds-a-title-page-walk, ask-annotates-a-screenshot-walk clean; ask-is-command-k-on-a-video-walk 'as declared' (its setup holds the front, every tick lost names only the probe) while it started the shared server. askModelsOnly walks (deletes-an-older-model, offers-the-new-default-model) pass on their own servers. The people-facing app: sharing is only switched on by a walk's setup (AskModelServer.walkShares), so dev and release Ask are unchanged by construction; not exercised in the dev app (runners never touch it). Chose lazy start from the probe over the scripts pre-loading it, because a run with no walk that asks the model must not load 23 GB. Left rough (no task: covered or under the bar): the picture model still loads per walk that paints a photo.
owns these walks: ask-is-command-k-on-a-video-walk, ask-makes-a-photo-walk, ask-paints-before-brushes-walk

Ask walks share one llama-server per walk run: started detached and gently by the first probe that needs it (PhotonzCore AskWalkServer, unit tested; app AskWalkServerProcess), adopted by later walks, stopped by playtest-all/playtest.sh/go-loop or its own watch (run gone, 180 s idle). Measured: 36 Ask walks via playtest-all, llama-server sampled every 2 s, max 1, one load; gentle 212/39.7 t/s vs 232/42.8, GPU p99 4.2 vs 2.8 ms. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-30-ask-walks-share-one-model.json. Only 4 Ask walks reach the model today (Ask button regression logged on walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26).
